title: Tool Use and Function Calling
prerequisites: Phase 14 · 01 (Agent Loop), Phase 13 · 01 (Function Calling Deep Dive)
objectives: Explain Toolformer's self-supervised training signal: keep tool annotations only when execution reduces next-token loss.
